# Short Bio (i.e. TLDR)

I am a doctoral student in the [Swedish Graduate School of Digital Philology](https://www.uu.se/institution/lingvistik-och-filologi/utbildning/tidiga-sprak-digital-filologi) at [Lund University](https://www.sol.lu.se/person/AlbinThornCleland/). In my research, I apply statistics and machine learning to very old texts, mainly written in Ancient Greek.

# Current Research 

I am part of a research project on Ancient Greek [textual restoration, parsing, and metrical scansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07249) as well as [the first fully general models for automatic disambiguation of vowel length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01935). 
Right now I am doing topic analysis of large corpora of papyrus imputations.

I have also recently done work on the melody of [the songs of Aristophanes' comedies](articles/aristophanes/aristophanes-june-15.pdf) and the victory odes of Pindar.
